description: Vietnam - Wind Measurement Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Wind", published or maintained by Clara Ivanescu (World Bank Group). Wind Measurement Data from the World Bank funded project "Vietnam Wind Resource Assessment", recorded from 3 sites (Phang Rang, Phan Thiet, Plei Ku) between 12.2008 and 02.2009. Please refer to the country project page for additional outputs and reports, including installation reports: For access to maps and GIS layers, please visit the Global Wind Atlas:. Coverage: Vietnam. It has 4 files in CSV, PDF. The portal files it under Wind. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
